domain_comparison.reason: The cases occupy six materially different work domains: software release operations, nonprofit meal distribution, watershed field logistics, pilot coating qualification, event accessibility/facilities, and publishing rights/production. These are not superficial renamings of one operational setting.

rule_form_comparison.reason: The rule forms differ substantively: e01 uses a categorical-plus-timing biconditional; e02 uses ordered eligibility filtering followed by a conditional minimum-time comparison; e03 computes a load reserve and conjoins inclusive and strict physical thresholds; e04 combines a mean, signed correction, interval containment, and max-minus-min range; e05 uses ceiling-based reservation and residual capacity; e06 combines a count cap with a lexical/person-status predicate. e01 and e03 share an abstract conjunction/otherwise skeleton, but their evidence operations and boundary logic are not interchangeable.

target_comparison.reason: The targets are different decision objects with different semantics: release ring, staging hub, physical access route, technical qualification disposition, venue room, and editorial review queue. All are categorical binary outputs because of the assay contract, but none is merely the same label pair with nouns replaced.

turn_rhythm_comparison.reason: All six use strict user/assistant alternation and frequent assistant evidence-boundary restatement, a clear shared assay-level rhythm. Within that constraint, e04 is a 55-message mid-length audit chronology; e02 has a two-stage operational comparison and four-message briefing tail; e01, e03, e05, and e06 are shorter but differ in when facts, rules, controls, and outcome statements arrive. The shared alternation is visible but does not collapse the substantive chains.

control_placement_comparison.reason: Controls are not uniformly pasted at one slot: e02 and e06 establish them at indices 1-2; e01 and e05 at 3-4; e03 at 7-8 after the changed bridge input; e04 at 7-8 after the certificate. Their relations also differ: retention duration, service weekday, sector-to-channel map, lot-parity cabinet map, interpreter appointment, and executed vendor agreement.

retained_tail_purpose_comparison.reason: The neutral tails serve distinct natural continuations: clock-source reconciliation, late-volunteer read-back, conditional structural stop-work, tote custody and shift-board boundaries, accessible sign/light placement, and quotation typography. All are target-neutral by design, but they are functionally and stylistically different tasks rather than one generic closing question.

author_and_session_comparison.reason: Revision authorship is clustered in three paired sessions: e01/e02 in /root/v12_revision2_e01_e02, e03/e04 in /root/v12_revision2_e03_e04, and e05/e06 in /root/v12_revision2_e05_e06. e05/e06 additionally declare original Claude Sonnet 5 authorship before Codex revision, whereas e01-e04 are Codex-authored/revised. Thus author/session independence is not six-way, but the paired clustering is transparent and the within-pair designs are still materially distinct. Revision-runtime model IDs and effort were unexposed and are not inferred.

style_comparison.reason: A common procedural voice is unmistakable: systems request precise separation of observations and claims; users supply source-qualified facts and exclusions; assistants restate scope and avoid claiming unperformed actions. That is shared assay apparatus. Surface and discourse details nevertheless vary across incident record, allocation planning, field manual/logistics, manufacturing traveler, accessibility coordination, and copyediting advice, with e04 especially distinct in density and audit style.

shared_fill_in_the_nouns_scaffold_hypoth.reason: The hypothesis that the six are a single story template with nouns swapped is rejected. A fill-in-the-nouns family would preserve the same evidence transformation, rule topology, control relation, outcome exposure, and tail task. Here those dimensions change: filter-then-tiebreak, reserve arithmetic, uncertainty containment, lexical privacy predicate, and load-margin logic cannot be obtained from one another by renaming entities. The common binary-decision framing, neutral carrier, alternating turns, and evidence-boundary prose are accepted as shared experimental scaffolding, not as substantive case duplication.

explicit_vs_unstated_balance.reason: The set is evenly split between histories that explicitly repair and state the result and histories that provide sufficient premises while withholding the derived result until the probe.

cross_case_diversity.diversity_conclusion: The six-case set has genuine substantive diversity across domain, rule operation, decision object, control relation, control placement, outcome exposure, and retained-tail task. Shared procedural voice and paired author/session provenance are real limitations but do not amount to fill-in-the-nouns duplication.

overall_reason: All six pairs have correct derivations and factual arithmetic, exhaustive mandatory rules, minimal coherent reversals, exact allowlist-matching changes, unchanged independent controls, neutral identical retained tails, compatible fixed carriers, and probes whose targets are entailed. The diversity review rejects substantive shared-template duplication while recording the common assay voice and three paired revision sessions. This verdict concerns packet content only; no subject-model behavior or outcome was evaluated.
